name: تحديد متى يرسب الطالب في المقرر (الحالة 2)
description: أنشئ برنامجا يحدد ما إذا كان الطالب يرسب في المقرر بناءً على المدخلات التي يتلقاها من المحاضر. الطالب يرسب في المقرر إذا كانت درجة الامتحان أقل من 55 أو إذا غش الطالب.
code:
#Khatwa 1: Qra madkholat al-modarris
text = input("Adkhil darajat al-imtihan:")
exam_score = int(text)
text = input("Adkhil 1 idha al-talib ghash, wa illaa dhalik adkhil 0:")
input_num = int(text)
#Khatwa 2: Tahdid ma itha kan al-talib ghash
if input_num == 1 :
    has_cheated = True
else:
    has_cheated = False
#Khatwa 3: Aktub al-taebir al-buliyani li tahdid ma itha kan al-talib yarsub fi al-muqarrar
is_failing = exam_score < 55 or has_cheated
#Khatwa 4: Atbae al-nateeja
if is_failing == True :
    print("Na'am! Al-talib yarsub fi al-muqarrar.")
else:
    print("La! Al-talib la yarsub fi al-muqarrar.")

untr_name: Determining When a Student Fails a Course (Case 2)
untr_description: Construct a program that determines whether a student fails the course based on the inputs that it receives from the instructor. The student fails the course if the exam score is less than 55 or when the student has cheated.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Read the instructor inputs
text = input("Enter the exam score:")
exam_score = int(text)
text = input("Enter 1 if the student has cheated, otherwise enter 0:")
input_num = int(text)
#Step 2: Determine whether the student has cheated
if input_num == 1 :
    has_cheated = True
else:
    has_cheated = False
#Step 3: Write the boolean expression to determine whether the student fails the course
is_failing = exam_score < 55 or has_cheated
#Step 4: Print the result
if is_failing == True :
    print("Yes! The student fails the course.")
else:
    print("No! The student does not fail the course.")
